prompt: coupled R5: gyroid infill in cellular foam pockets
limitations: Coupled geometry is SDF-only (mesh export); the coupling is evaluated pointwise, not as a B-Rep.
Fused designs use manifold dual contouring; a few pinches narrower than one voxel can still give non-manifold edges (under 0.1 % of the edges at 96 cells, see docs/NONMANIFOLD.md).
No exact B-Rep for this design: STL/glTF come from surface nets of the SDF; STEP export is unavailable.
SDF surface resolution is limited to h = 0.1042 mm (constraints.resolution = 192); features below ~2h are not resolved.
Genus is the first Betti number of the voxel solid (independent handles); it depends on the grid resolution.
Connectivity counts components of at least 27 grid nodes; smaller slivers are reported in observations and not repaired.

min_wall_thickness = 5th percentile of inward-ray chords (absolute minimum reported separately); entry/exit error about ±h/2 = ±0.052 mm; 6 sub-voxel chords discarded. Not a certified manufacturing check.
Repair is capped at 5 rounds and runs one parameter change per round (greedy, no search).
Repairs act on the SDF/B-Rep parameters; they do not change the code structure (priority 3 is not automated).
unknowns: Resolution above 160 per axis may exceed browser memory budgets.
